title: Application Engineer, Laboratory (Tuzla)
desc:
About this Position
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to application engineering through laboratory testing, analytical methods, and technical support. You will collaborate with customers, Application Engineering teams, Key Account Managers, and project teams to support technical requests and projects, develop and optimize testing methods, and contribute to continuous improvement in laboratory processes and product performance.
What You´ll Do
Standardize and develop new test methods using a broad range of analytical techniques, including both destructive and non-destructive testing
Leverage customer feedback to drive continuous optimization in customer service and laboratory testing processes
Track, manage, and document test reports within the laboratory systems.
Perform peer reviews of test data and result entries to ensure data accuracy and quality
Participate in test standard validations and support training activities for internal stakeholders (e.g. laboratory personnel, marketing, sales)
Prepare and deliver internal presentations related to testing methods, standards, and results
Apply consultative skills when interacting with customers to build trust and transparency while managing technical incidents
Participate in customer meetings and presentations, providing consultation on best practices relevant to the application field
Communicate and collaborate closely with Application Engineering field roles, Key Account Managers (KAMs), project teams, and customers
Lead and coordinate internal and external technical requests and application-related projects
Ensure laboratory and application equipment are properly calibrated and safety-checked in compliance with local regulations
Collect quotations and procure the necessary chemicals and equipment for the laboratory.
Monitor trends in analytical methods and play a key role in the laboratory's development.
Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities and ensure the completion of Corrective Action Plans related to customer complaints and overall product performance
What Makes You a Good Fit
Bachelor's degree in chemistry or chemical engineering
2-4 years of related experience, preferably laboratory experience
Ability to work independently, communicate with laboratory members, and maintain organized records/reports
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of management
Solution-oriented and ability to work as a team
Advanced user of MS Office applications
Some perks of joining Henkel
Diverse national and international growth opportunities
Global wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
Gender-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks
Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares
At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We look for a diverse team of individuals who possess different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and mindsets.
